name: dynamo.run_graph_interactive
description: Opens the Run Graph dialog in Revit. Invoked from the 'Run Graph…' button on the Tools tab, NOT from chat — the LLM should use dynamo.run_graph instead and ask the user for missing inputs in conversation.

graph_path.description: Absolute path to the Dynamo graph file (.dyn).

suggested_inputs.description: Optional values to pre-populate the form, keyed by input node Name (same names used by dynamo.run_graph). Call dynamo.describe_graph first if you don't know the input names.

status.description: What happened: 'ran' = user clicked Run and the graph executed; 'cancelled' = user closed the dialog without running; 'error' = something failed.

inputs_used.description: The values the user actually entered (when status='ran'). May differ from suggested_inputs.

examples.description: Let the user fill in inputs themselves
Suggest values from the conversation, but let the user confirm
